atomistic-materials.published_measurement: Matbench Discovery evaluates stability classification and thermal-conductivity error, among other physical endpoints.
atomistic-materials.ssi_implementation: SSI computes the equal arithmetic mean (1/8 each) of signed skills across eight physical suites (Discovery, Phonons, Elasticity, Thermal conductivity, Metal–organic frameworks, Amorphous materials, Cleavage, and Migration barriers) anchored against zero-force controls (including D3(BJ) dispersion on MOF bulk modulus), clipped to [0, 1] at the top level.

brain-computer-interface-decoding.published_measurement: CBraMod reports held-out decoding results per dataset, including balanced accuracy for TUEV.
brain-computer-interface-decoding.ssi_implementation: SSI averages subject/session-stratified chance-adjusted balanced accuracy equally across four EEG tracks (TUEV, AD65, OpenBMI, and longitudinal decoding), omitting the deprecated FACED track due to cross-subject stimulus recurrence and excluding overlapping TUEV pretrained weights (BIOT).

crystal-structure-generation.published_measurement: LeMat-GenBench reports stability, uniqueness and novelty using reference hulls, and compares generated and relaxed structures. MatterGen also evaluates stability relative to a convex hull.
crystal-structure-generation.ssi_implementation: SSI computes (SUN + 0.5 * MetaSUN) / 2,500 requested structures after UMA-200 relaxation with matched three-potential convex hulls (delta E_hull <= 0 for strict SUN, 0 < delta E_hull <= 0.1 eV/atom for MetaSUN). As-submitted geometry, negative formation energy, relaxation RMSD, and element-arity distributions are retained as separate diagnostics.

sources.title: LeMat authors on the reference MACE checkpoint

earth-observation-pretraining-transfer.published_measurement: OlmoEarth evaluates African Wildlife Foundation land-cover classification and live fuel moisture regression as distinct downstream tasks.
earth-observation-pretraining-transfer.ssi_implementation: SSI takes the equal mean of majority-class chance-adjusted AWF classification skill on the spatially disjoint 205-window blind test split ((acc - 59/205) / (1 - 59/205) via frozen 20-NN probe) and LFMC test MAE skill (1 - lfmc_test_mae / 24.435180349813233), clipped to [0, 1]. All test-overlapping spatial windows are removed from the development container.

fluid-flow-control.published_measurement: HydroGym evaluates physical objectives such as drag and lift using controlled and uncontrolled flows.
fluid-flow-control.ssi_implementation: Across 26 CFD cases grouped into 10 physical flow families (equal 1/10 family weight), SSI computes direction-corrected signed improvement relative to paired zero actuation clipped to [-1, 1] per case (failed/diverged cases score -1) on blind initial-state perturbation seeds, clipped to [0, 1] at the top level.

fruit-fly-neuron-reconstruction.published_measurement: FFN measures the error-free neurite path length and reports merge errors. Local Shape Descriptors reports ERL and variation of information. PATHFINDER reports normalized ERL, splits and merges.
fruit-fly-neuron-reconstruction.ssi_implementation: [HOLD — Metric redesign deferred to dedicated standalone review] Currently retains the frozen SHAPE local sparse nERL on the archived MaleCNS core, with image-free oversegmentation controls recorded as diagnostics.

genome-sequence-to-function.published_measurement: Enformer evaluates genome-track predictions by correlation. AlphaGenome reports assay-specific metrics, including separate splice metrics.
genome-sequence-to-function.ssi_implementation: SSI combines 0.5 * Functional genomic tracks (equal mean across 5 track modalities pooling 11 assay families by Pearson correlation) + 0.5 * Variant and perturbation effects (equal mean across 5 chance-calibrated benchmark branches, excluding redundant eqtl_sign).

mass-spectrometry-molecule-retrieval.published_measurement: MassSpecGym evaluates candidate retrieval separately per query spectrum using accuracy at k.
mass-spectrometry-molecule-retrieval.ssi_implementation: SSI evaluates top-1 identification accuracy (Hit@1) with equal spectrum weights over all 17,556 MassSpecGym v1.5 mass-pool spectra using a persistent single-spectrum sequential streaming protocol (massspecgym-retrieval-stream/v2) paired with a 128-query repeated-pool-stratified shuffled cold-start full-ranking statelessness spot-check. Top-5, top-20 and MCES@1 remain diagnostics.

molecular-pretraining-transfer.published_measurement: Uni-Mol2 evaluates downstream molecular-property regression errors, including MAE on QM9 and COMPAS-1D.
molecular-pretraining-transfer.ssi_implementation: SSI computes macro-averaged relative absolute error (MA-RAE) across 24 endpoints grouped equally into four benchmark families (QM9, COMPAS-1D, ExpansionRx, and ASAP) and maps the equal four-group mean to 1 / (1 + mean_4_groups(MA-RAE)).

natural-disease-progression.published_measurement: Prospective disease trajectory work evaluates future coded diagnoses. Clinical alert studies evaluate sensitivity against alert workload.
natural-disease-progression.ssi_implementation: SSI measures 365-day incident case capture (Recall@5% alert budget) equally weighted across 17 eligible disease endpoints on the held-out 11,424-patient MIMIC-IV cohort with prior family-history exclusions.

sources.title: Clinical alert tradeoffs, JAMA Network Open

pde-surrogate.published_measurement: The Well reports variance-scaled rollout errors. Numerical baseline studies emphasize comparison with competitive conventional solvers.
pde-surrogate.ssi_implementation: SSI takes the equal mean across four rollout dataset groups (ape2d, pdearena, well/active_matter, and well/turbulent_radiative_layer_2D) of (1 - log10(clip(VRMSE, 0.01, 10))) / 3. Inference wall-clock time is logged in report.json alongside an observation-grid coarse numerical solver control.

sources.title: Weak baselines and numerical methods, Nature Machine Intelligence

probabilistic-global-weather.published_measurement: GenCast and WeatherBench 2 evaluate probabilistic forecasts with CRPS across variables and lead times. WeatherBench 2 includes climatological comparisons.
probabilistic-global-weather.ssi_implementation: SSI evaluates empirical ensemble CRPS (fair=False, per contract) normalized by frozen training scales across a 10-variable global forecast panel and maps the equal-weighted panel mean to 1 / (1 + normalized_crps).

protein-design.published_measurement: RFdiffusion3 uses structure- and interaction-specific success criteria for distinct design tasks.
protein-design.ssi_implementation: SSI weights the four native novel designability pass rates by target count: unconditional / 51 + (50 / 153) * (sm_binder + ppi_binder + enzyme). PPI inverse-folds only the binder conditioned on the fixed target structure before RF3 complex refolding; enzyme retains the upstream RFdiffusion3 AME catalytic-motif all-atom RMSD <= 1.5 A and non-motif ligand clash criteria.

sources.title: RFdiffusion binder design and computational filtering, Nature

protein-folding-prediction.published_measurement: FoldBench evaluates monomers by structural agreement and interfaces by task-specific success criteria, including DockQ and ligand metrics.
protein-folding-prediction.ssi_implementation: SSI takes the equal mean across five structural modalities (Protein monomers, Nucleic-acid monomers, Protein interfaces, Protein–nucleic acid, and Protein–ligand) aggregating nine FoldBench tracks in a label-isolated two-container sandbox. Interface success requires DockQ >= 0.23 AND (LRMSD <= 10.0 A OR iRMSD <= 4.0 A), with missing or invalid targets included in denominators.

protein-sequence-modeling.published_measurement: PEER reports task-specific prediction quality for protein functions, structure and other sequence tasks.
protein-sequence-modeling.ssi_implementation: SSI computes the equal mean across four PEER capability pillars (Function, Localization, Structure, and Protein interactions) using chance-calibrated balanced accuracy for six classification tasks, baseline-calibrated SS3 accuracy, Spearman correlation, affinity RMSE skill, and symmetric (A,B)/(B,A) probability averaging on undirected PPI tasks.

single-cell-perturbation-prediction.published_measurement: A calibration study evaluates weighted error of mean perturbation profiles against positive and negative controls. Independent benchmarking motivates comparison with simple across-perturbation baselines.
single-cell-perturbation-prediction.ssi_implementation: Across near, mid and far contexts, SSI computes signed amplitude skill (cross-fitted WMSE excluding target-gene readout) and masked-gene identification skill (calibrated NIR), takes their signed mean first and applies a per-context floor max(0, 0.5 * amplitude_skill + 0.5 * identification_skill), then averages equally across the three contexts while enforcing two-pass (full + shuffled subset) query independence.

surface-code-decoding.published_measurement: AlphaQubit measures logical decoding errors on experimental surface codes and reports the logical error rate per round.
surface-code-decoding.ssi_implementation: SSI averages logical decoding success (1 - logical failure probability) equally across code distances 3 and 5 over its frozen Sycamore panel with keyed HMAC-SHA256 shuffled test sample identifiers. Per-round logical error rate remains a diagnostic.

target-based-drug-screening.published_measurement: BEDROC weights early recognition of active compounds in ranked screening lists.
target-based-drug-screening.ssi_implementation: SSI computes BEDROC (alpha = 80.5) per target and takes 0.5 * DUD-E + 0.5 * LIT-PCBA macro-averaged BEDROC under unidirectional target pocket coverage decontamination (--cov-mode 1 -c 0.8 --min-seq-id 0.3). EF1% and swapped-pocket counterfactual BEDROC are reported as diagnostics.

sources.title: Truchon and Bayly, Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

timeseries-forecasting.published_measurement: GIFT-Eval evaluates point and probabilistic forecasting after scaling errors against seasonal naive forecasts, aggregating relative metrics geometrically.
timeseries-forecasting.ssi_implementation: Over 97 unique GIFT-Eval configurations, SSI scales MASE and WQL against frozen Seasonal Naive references (with single-application log-linear penalty toward 10.0 for partial coverage), aggregates log-ratios hierarchically across 7 domains -> 23 sources -> forecast horizons, and maps to 1 - exp(mean_domain(log_ratio)) clipped to [0, 1].

tokamak-magnetic-control.published_measurement: Magnetic-control experiments evaluate plasma tracking, including boundary shape, position and current.
tokamak-magnetic-control.ssi_implementation: SSI evaluates joint shape-control successes out of all 105 scheduled episodes (7 plasma scenarios x 15 private perturbation seeds, counting void/disrupted episodes in the denominator) while passing only an independent public policy seed to controller reset_context().

sources.title: Magnetic control of tokamak plasmas, Nature
